Family or coach buys the device

XbotGo

Blink Tech, Inc. · Mountain View, California, United States (with offices in Texas, Beijing, Shenzhen and Suzhou) · founded 2020 · active · xbotgo.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Family or coach buys the devicePortable unitEvidence A€500 to €2,000 to start

XbotGo sells two consumer AI tracking cameras, the Chameleon phone gimbal from about USD 300 and the standalone 4K Falcon from USD 799, with tracking, livestream and 20 GB cloud storage included and paid AI match analysis on top xbotgo-01, xbotgo-02, xbotgo-12.

For Parents, volunteer coaches and small clubs who want a hands free recording of a match for a one off price and are happy to manage SD cards and uploads themselves xbotgo-01, xbotgo-03. It also fits European buyers, since the store prices in euro from a European warehouse xbotgo-10, xbotgo-11.

XbotGo exists because a computer vision engineer and soccer dad, David Tan, saw that the phone in every parent's pocket could become a tracking camera if a cheap gimbal did the panning, and the Chameleon sold to over 150,000 users on that idea xbotgo-05. It matters now because the Falcon, funded with USD 2.55 million from 5,099 Kickstarter backers and on general sale since March 2026, brings native 4K, an integrated AI processor and no mandatory subscription to a price under USD 1,000, which undercuts the leased and subscription camera models xbotgo-04, xbotgo-06. It tells you the hardware side of this market is commoditising fast, so the durable value is moving to analysis, distribution and consent tooling, none of which XbotGo yet does well xbotgo-12, xbotgo-09.

Price band Chameleon USD 299.99 (EUR 329.99) one off; Falcon USD 799 (EUR 869) one off, bundles to USD 1,029; Pro Soccer analysis USD 15 per match promotional, USD 23.99 list xbotgo-02

Italy The XbotGo store shows euro prices for Italian visitors, with the Falcon at EUR 869 and bundles at EUR 1,049 and EUR 1,119, served from the company's European warehouse, and no Italian reseller or club deployment was found xbotgo-11, xbotgo-10.

Products

  • XbotGo Falcon (camera). Standalone dual sensor 4K AI camera with 6 TOPS processor, 360 degree pan, about 4 hours battery, microSD up to 1 TB, WiFi 6, livestream and RTMP xbotgo-01, xbotgo-06.
  • XbotGo Chameleon (camera). 360 degree rotating smartphone mount with AI tracking, about 8 hours battery, output resolution set by the phone xbotgo-03.
  • XbotGo app (app). iOS and Android app for zone mapping, recording, livestream, cloud upload, team sharing and Pro Soccer ordering xbotgo-01, xbotgo-14.
  • Pro Soccer analysis (add-on). Per match AI highlights and tactical report within 24 hours, credit based, launched September 2026 xbotgo-12, xbotgo-13.
  • XbotGo cloud (platform). 20 GB free storage with team sharing and indefinite storage of analysis results xbotgo-06, xbotgo-16.

Scale, company-stated

Over 150,000 Chameleon users, September 2025 xbotgo-05; 203,156 active members, 500 plus teams, 100 plus countries and 5,226,000 hours recorded per the company's About page, September 2026 xbotgo-08.

2025 and 2026

  • 2025-09-02: Falcon Kickstarter launches and passes USD 1 million in two hours xbotgo-05.
  • 2025-10-17: Kickstarter closes at USD 2,548,287 from 5,099 backers xbotgo-04.
  • 2025-12-04: Cal South renews XbotGo partnership xbotgo-15.
  • 2026-03-06: Falcon goes on global public sale at USD 699 xbotgo-06.
  • 2026-09-01: Pro Soccer AI analysis launches, shown at IFA Berlin xbotgo-13.
  • 2026-09: Falcon listed at USD 799 and app version 5.0.1 released xbotgo-02, xbotgo-14.
